==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Wei:''' Hello! Are you also here to submit to "Tidal Geography" of the [[Pioneer Association]]?
:{{DIcon}} No, I'm just looking around.
:'''Wei:''' Well... If you don't mind, could you take a look at the submission I prepared this time?
:'''Wei:''' I started making submissions not long ago, and I don't know if everyone likes my photos.
:{{DIcon}} The shot is great.
:'''Wei:''' Thank you. The publisher started a new column called "Return to the Front Tide" in collaboration with big-shot photographers of the [[New Federation]] and the Pioneer Association. It's open for public submission regularly.
:'''Wei:''' There's no requirement for experience and themes, which means even a nobody photographer like me can take a shot.
:'''Wei:''' I heard that the selected photos will be used for image reconstruction using AI to restore the scenes of the world before [[the Lament]].
:'''Wei:''' We can see the former glory of the skyscrapers from the remnants, and what used to be a lustrous sea of flowers from the withered petals.
:'''Wei:''' Just like magic. Takes everyone back to the past.
{{Dialogue End}}
